title: Keyboard manager Bug (Allow chords activating)
author: Freddycatala31
summary: A shortcut saved with Allow chords disabled reopens with the option enabled, despite the saved editor choice.
next_action: Reproduce with a fresh and an existing settings profile and compare the serialized chord flag before and after reopening.

confidence.rationale: The reporter provides a concise sequence and diagnostics; only configuration dependence remains uncertain.

judgment.rationale: The report contains a minimal save/reopen sequence, before-and-after screenshots, and a diagnostic ZIP; one non-reproduction makes a controlled configuration comparison useful.
evidence: The reporter reproduces by creating a shortcut, disabling Allow chords, saving, and reopening the editor.
Screenshots show the intended disabled state and the reopened enabled state.
A PowerToys 0.100.2 diagnostic archive is attached, while one commenter could not reproduce on the same version.
judgment.recommended_action: Reproduce with a fresh and an existing settings profile and compare the serialized chord flag before and after reopening.

fix_assessment.rationale: The report is reproducible enough for targeted maintainer verification, but the write-versus-read ownership is not established by public evidence.

issue_context.summary: A shortcut saved with Allow chords disabled reopens with the option enabled, despite the saved editor choice.
known_information: The report is against PowerToys 0.100.2 from Microsoft Store.
The option changes only after save and reopening.
The issue includes both screenshots and a diagnostic ZIP.
inferences: The failure may depend on default-value omission, migration, or one shortcut shape rather than the toggle control alone.
issue_context.analysis: A two-profile serialization check can identify whether the editor writes the wrong value, drops an explicit false, or reads a missing value as true.
initial_investigation: Read the full live report, attached-evidence references, and non-reproduction comment.
Compared the symptom with #47941 and the broader state-persistence tracker #47806.

actions.label: Reproduce Allow chords persistence
actions.note: Maintainer-side verification only; this artifact performs no upstream write.

reproduce.title: Compare saved chord state in fresh and migrated profiles
prerequisites: One fresh settings profile and one profile upgraded from 0.99 or 0.100
setup: Record the shortcut entry and the serialized Allow chords value before editing.
steps: Open the shortcut editor, disable Allow chords, save, and close it.
Inspect the saved editor settings to confirm whether false is present.
Reopen the editor and record the displayed value.
Repeat with the migrated profile and compare default handling.
reproduce.expected_result: Allow chords remains disabled after save and reopen, and the serialized value round-trips consistently in fresh and migrated profiles.
